column1: # CHAOS-8305: profile rows whose route a Go WILDCARD handler serves by comparing a literal path value in code, so the
# registered pattern (the wildcard) does not show the literal. Columns (tab separated): method, the profile row's route,
# the registered wildcard pattern, the literal the handler compares, file:line of that comparison, the proof that runs: "unit"
# (the gate executes it: the literal reaches its handler, a planted sibling literal on the same wildcard answers 405/404) or
# "integration" (needs an authenticated request on real stores: the integration shard, CHAOS-pending until it exists).
# A row whose proof does not run fails.
# Shrinks to nothing when the handlers register explicit routes (CHAOS-8320).
